content.title: Pooh Shiesty among several arrested for robbing, kidnapping other rappers, including Gucci Mane, DOJ says
content.text: Memphis rapper Pooh Shiesty and his father were among several people who were arrested Wednesday for robbing and kidnapping other rappers in Dallas, including Gucci Mane, according to the Department of Justice.On Thursday, North Texas U.S. Attorney Ryan Raybould held a press conference alleging that Lontrell Williams Jr. — better known as Pooh Shiesty — held one of the robbery victims at gunpoint during a "business meeting" in Dallas in January."Once these three men were inside the recording studio, Williams Jr. and eight co-conspirators, several of whom traveled from Memphis, Tennessee, executed a coordinated armed takeover. As alleged, Williams Jr. produced an AK-style pistol and forced one of the victims to sign a release from the recording contract at gunpoint," Raybould said.One of the victims in the indictment was identified as "RD," which matches the initials of Radric Davis, or Gucci Mane.Pooh Shiesty is a rapper under Atlanta rapper Gucci Mane's record label 1017 Records.Raybould said eight of the nine people charged in the robbery and kidnapping were arrested Wednesday in Dallas, Memphis and Nashville. Besides the elder and junior Williams, they are Rodney Wright Jr., Kedarius Waters, Terrance Rodgers, Damarian Gipson, Demarcus Glover, Kordae Johnson and Darrion McDaniel.Wright is a Memphis rapper known as Big30.Raybould said Pooh Shiesty and co-conspirators then robbed the victims. "The remaining conspirators displayed firearms and robbed the other victims of Rolex watches, jewelry, cash, and other high value items," he said.Raybould said they later posted on social media some of the jewelry allegedly stolen, including a "1017" chain and a Rolex.He went on to say Pooh Shiesty was on home detention and had on an electronic monitoring device: "Part of the terms of his home detention were that he would not commit another a federal offense or possess a firearm. His father, Lontrell Williams Sr., is alleged to have helped plan and execute the federal kidnaping as charged in the complaint."The indictment includes stills from surveillance video from the recording studio as well as a motel and other businesses nearby. There are photos of several defendants.Raybould laid out some of the other evidence included in the indictment against the defendants, including Williams Sr."Rental car records confirming Williams Sr. rented a vehicle that was used by the group. Surveillance footage from the offense location, a nearby office supply store, and a hotel where several of the defendants stayed following the offense. Fingerprint evidence as well that was recovered from the crime scene, matching at least two of the defendants," Raybould said.Eight of the nine defendants were arrested on the same day FBI agents raided Pooh Shiesty's family home in Cordova. Jail records show that the rapper's father, Williams Sr., was arrested Wednesday in Memphis.RELATED: FBI executes search and arrest warrant at Pooh Shiesty's family home in CordovaIn October, Pooh Shiesty was released from a federal prison in Pennsylvania, where he was serving a 63-month sentence.He was sentenced in 2023 for shooting a man at a Florida hotel three years earlier. He pleaded guilty to a firearms conspiracy charge to avoid a worse sentence.He has been held in a halfway house in Dallas since his release from federal prison.Williams Sr., Wright Jr., and three other defendants are scheduled for a detention hearing in Memphis on Friday.To read the full indictment, click on the PDF below:
